contents.Text: [[[underline:Soft Purple]]] ≈ Start
[[[underline:Soft Yellow]]] ≈ Regenerate list
[[[underline:Dark Blue]]] ≈ Custom Order
[[[underline:Light Green]]] ≈ Cursor skip multiplier
[[[underline:Pale Orange]]] ≈ Cursor Mover
Starts the download process.
[[[warning:Note:]]] The button is disabled once the download starts, so two download processes are never started at once (the download itself is multithreaded).
Regenerates the [[[strong:Custom Order]]] list, with new results added at the bottom of the list.
[[[warning:Note:]]] The button turns [[[strong:red]]] to show that the list needs to be regenerated before starting the download.
[[[warning:Note:]]] This may be removed in the future, as the ordering in the list has become largely redundant over time.
Arrange your music by organizing a scrollable list of playlists or songs.
The list is an ordered hierarchy: items near the top take priority over items near the bottom, so if the same URL is in two different folders, it knows which one to prioritise.
[[[strong:Tip:]]] For most people, individual song links should be at the top and playlists at the bottom.

rows: Click on an item to select it (known as the [[[strong:cursor]]])
Use the [[[strong:Cursor Mover]]] buttons to rearrange the order

contents.Text: Playlists, artists and other collections are not compared as a whole. They are first broken down into a pool of individual song URLs, and then those song URLs are compared.

If the same song URL turns up in two different folders, the order decides which one is kept. The one nearest the top is downloaded and the one lower down is skipped, so you never end up with a duplicate.
[[[strong:Example:]]] If a song is downloaded into one folder near the top, and a playlist lower down also contains that exact song URL, that song is skipped in the lower folder.
[[[warning:Note:]]] Duplicates are only ever removed from folders lower in the order than the one that keeps the song, and this happens during the download process.
This multiplier affects the [[[strong:Cursor Mover]]].
For example, if the number is [[[strong:2]]], each press of up or down in the [[[strong:Cursor Mover]]] moves the cursor that many spaces in the [[[strong:Custom Order]]].
[[[strong:Tip:]]] Change the number to how many spaces you want to move, to speed up traversing large lists.
This moves the selected item up or down in the [[[strong:Custom Order]]].
